journal_lines: §aCanopy here closes over the sky completely. §oBrown light. Smells like mushroom and old wood and something else.§o Worked the edge. Took §lDark Oak§l.
§aMushrooms up the trunks, not just the floor. This forest does things differently.
§aClaw marks on a trunk, higher than comfortable. Worked the far side of that tree.
§aThe inside of the dark oak is pale. §oNot what you'd expect from bark that dark.§o Good timber though.
§aToadstools in rings. Stepped around them. No particular reason. Just felt right.
§aSomething coughed in the understory. Once. Did not repeat. Kept the axe moving.
§aWorked quickly. The trees here hold their ground longer than other trees.
§aFound a clearing and used it for the work. The trees leaned in around the edge.
§aLight never fully reaches the floor here. §oDid everything by smell and touch and the shape of the axe landing.§o Good §lDark Oak§l.
§aTook what I came for and left at a pace that was not quite running.
